name: @aisha/design-language
description: The surface design language: tokens, utility classes and presentational components every extranet surface composes. Two first-class themes (carbon/daylight), semantic tokens as the single instance-override point, provenance-first data display. Not to be confused with @aisha/design-tokens, which brands the stack's INTERNAL surfaces — this package is the customer-facing design system, and an instance re-brands it by overriding semantic tokens in its public/tokens.css overlay, never by forking components.
